description: This file contains unit tests for the JPEG transcoding functionality within the OpenClawKit project. It defines test cases that generate JPEG images with different properties and verify the behavior of the transcoding process, including resizing, orientation normalization, and byte size constraints.

methods.name: makeSolidJPEG
methods.description: Generates a solid color JPEG image with specified width, height, and optional orientation.

methods.name: makeNoiseJPEG
methods.description: Creates a JPEG image filled with random noise pixels with specified width and height.

methods.name: downscalesToMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test case verifying the image downscaling to a maximum width.

methods.name: doesNotUpscaleWhenSmallerThanMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test case verifying that images smaller than max width are not upscaled.

methods.name: normalizesOrientationAndUsesOrientedWidthForMaxWidthPx
methods.description: Test case verifying orientation normalization and width handling.

methods.name: respectsMaxBytes
methods.description: Test case verifying the byte size constraint of the transcoded JPEG.
